about_the_game:
Take a giant leap as you pilot the iconic lunar module to a precision landing on a miniature moon landscape in this modern reimagining of a classic moon lander game.

This demo version features a selection of levels designed to immerse you in the unique miniature lunar landscape and give you a feel for the controls.

Carefully manage fuel and use precise inputs to touch down on designated landing spots. Whether you aim for efficient landings or simply enjoy the challenge of flight, this demo offers a taste of the skill-based gameplay and exploration awaiting in the full experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR, requires motion controllers
